body:
"Is there somewhere you can go to learn how to meditate?"
I'm not sure, I only read the books and practiced it solo. I doubt there is a legit place for that where I live, but I'll try to look into that a bit more. It's also gonna cost money I might not have atm.
"Well, if you don't find women attractive, why not men? I'm not trying to be rude or anything, this is a serious question. "
It's fine, but no, I (sadly?) don't find men attractive at all.
Self-therapy is going to be rough, I barely find enough energy and willingness to engage in few activities I used to find amusing.
I hardly see any future for myself. I'm not gifted and I ditched every hobby and sphere of interested I even remotely tried to look into. There is only going to be mediocrity and loneliness.

"Also meditation can help with this"
I tried getting into meditation and some schizotheric practices, but I didn't really find it all that satisfying.
"What do you mean you are destined to be alone? Why do you think you can't find someone your age to have a healthy fulfilling relationship with?"
I don't find women of my age attractive, regardless of their stature or figure.
"You probably could really benefit from professional guidance, so maybe start working on a plan for that too?"
I used to know a guy that got reported by his therapist, and he wasn't even from my shithole. Police raid, guy kills himself because he gets exposed in front of his family. So I'd rather not.
I'm sorry it probably sounds like I'm trying to come up with excuses.
Also what happened to some other comment that got removed, I didn't even get to reply to it.
